text: It is often said that Napoleon's soldiers shot off the Sphinx's nose. Yet drawings by the Danish traveler Frederic Norden, who visited in the 1730s, already show the face without its nose. They were printed long before Napoleon came to Egypt in 1798.
spoken_text: It is often said that Napoleon's soldiers shot off the Sphinx's nose. Yet drawings by the Danish traveler Frederic Norden, who visited in the seventeen thirties, already show the face without its nose. They were printed long before Napoleon came to Egypt in 1798.
